PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?grandfather ?grandfatherLabel WHERE {
  dbr:Mohammed_bin_Khalifa_bin_Zayed_Al_Nahyan dbp:father ?father .
  ?father dbp:father ?grandfather .
  OPTIONAL { ?grandfather rdfs:label ?grandfatherLabel .
             FILTER (lang(?grandfatherLabel) = "en") }
}
LIMIT 100
